Score new Persons under a saved external Bayesian calibration

Source: R/api-posterior-scoring.R
predict.mfrm_posterior_summary.Rd

Evaluate posterior ability distributions, cut-score decision probabilities, and posterior predictive rating distributions for new Persons against a validated read_mfrm_posterior() calibration without refitting the exported Stan or brms model.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mfrm_posterior_summary'
predict(
  object,
  newdata,
  type = c("ability", "both", "predictive"),
  conditioning = c("posterior", "plugin_mean"),
  level = 0.95,
  cut_scores = NULL,
  quad_points = 31L,
  missing = c("fail", "omit"),
  persons = NULL,
  allow_calibration_persons = FALSE,
  repeated_ratings = NULL,
  keep_person_draws = FALSE,
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'mfrm_posterior_scores'
print(x, digits = 3L, ...)

# S3 method for class 'mfrm_posterior_scores'
summary(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'summary.mfrm_posterior_scores'
print(x, digits = 3L, ...)

# S3 method for class 'mfrm_posterior_scores'
confint(object, parm = NULL, level = object$settings$level, ...)

# S3 method for class 'mfrm_posterior_scores'
as.data.frame(
  x,
  row.names = NULL,
  optional = FALSE,
  ...,
  what = c("estimates", "predictive", "decisions", "person_draws", "dispositions")
)

# S3 method for class 'mfrm_posterior_scores'
plot(
  x,
  type = c("intervals", "variance", "predictive"),
  persons = NULL,
  draw = TRUE,
  reference = NULL,
  preset = "standard",
  show_legend = TRUE,
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  caption = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

A validated mfrm_posterior_summary returned by read_mfrm_posterior(). Supported models are ordinary "RSM", ordinary "PCM", and one-family "GPCM" (both fixed standard-normal and estimated-population Stan bundles). Two-family product-slope GPCM bundles are excluded and fail before scoring.

newdata

Non-empty data.frame of long-format rating rows using the exported bundle's source column names (Person, declared non-Person facets, and Score). New Person IDs are expected; all non-Person facet levels and non-missing score categories must exist in the saved calibration.

type

Output scope: "ability" (default: Person posterior ability table and optional cut_scores decisions), "both" (ability table plus row-level posterior predictive score distributions), or "predictive" (ability table plus row-level posterior predictive score distributions, defaulting as.data.frame() and plot() to predictive outputs when inspected).

conditioning

Calibration conditioning mode:

"posterior"

(Default) Integrates ability continuously within each saved MCMC calibration draw \(\psi^{(m)}\) and averages the conditional posteriors equally across all \(M\) joint draws in posterior-draws.rds. Propagates joint calibration uncertainty into SD, [Lower, Upper], decisions, and predictive while holding \(p(\psi \mid y_{\mathrm{cal}})\) fixed (new Person responses do not update calibration parameters). Fails closed when posterior-draws.rds is absent.

"plugin_mean"

Scores conditional on a single calibration vector formed from marginal posterior means (locations, steps, exp(mean(log_component_slopes)) preserving unit geometric mean for one-family GPCM, and population_mean / population_sd when present). Excludes calibration-estimation uncertainty (BetweenSD and CalibrationVarShare are NA).

Passing "joint" fails with guidance to combine calibration and new rows in export_mfrm_model(), because updating \(\psi\) from new Persons requires refitting the full hierarchical model.

level

Equal-tailed posterior credible interval probability strictly between 0 and 1 (default 0.95).

cut_scores

Optional finite, strictly increasing numeric vector of ability cut scores on the exported model's ability metric, with optional distinct names. Computes posterior probabilities above each cut and within each band (Lower < ability <= Upper).

quad_points

Integer Gauss-Legendre order per sub-panel (7 to 121, default 31). Each Person is integrated on an eight-panel composite grid centered at the draw-specific posterior mode and verified at 2 * quad_points + 1 (63 by default, 504 composite nodes). Ability summaries and predictive distributions are checked separately; discrepancies above 1e-6 withhold the affected output. Agreement between two orders is a numerical diagnostic, not a rigorous error bound.

missing

Missing-score policy for newdata: "fail" (default) rejects NA scores; "omit" omits NA rows when updating ability (returning Status = "prior_only" if a Person has zero observed ratings, while still evaluating posterior predictive category probabilities for omitted rows when type includes "predictive").

persons

Optional character vector of distinct Person IDs in newdata to score and return; NULL scores all Persons in first-appearance order.

allow_calibration_persons

Logical (default FALSE). Scoring a Person who already contributed to the calibration sample double-counts their ratings under \(p(\psi \mid y_{\mathrm{cal}})\). Set TRUE only for explicit diagnostic or counterfactual comparisons; calibration members are flagged in CalibrationMember and their out-of-sample PersonLogMarginalLikelihood is set to NA.

repeated_ratings

Optional override ("review" or "independent") for duplicate observed Person-by-facet cells in newdata; NULL inherits the exported bundle's repeated_ratings setting.

keep_person_draws

Logical (default FALSE); if TRUE, retains $person_draws with each Person's per-draw conditional mean, conditional SD, and log marginal likelihood across the calibration draws.

...

Unused; checked to be empty.

x, parm, row.names, optional, digits, draw, reference, preset, show_legend, title, subtitle, caption

Arguments for print(), summary(), confint(), as.data.frame(), and plot() methods on mfrm_posterior_scores.

what

Table component for as.data.frame(): "estimates" (default, or "predictive" when x$settings$type == "predictive"), "predictive", "decisions", "person_draws", or "dispositions".

Value

An mfrm_posterior_scores object with:

estimates

One row per scored Person with Estimate, Median, SD, WithinSD, BetweenSD, CalibrationVarShare, Lower, Upper, PriorMean, PriorSD, PersonLogMarginalLikelihood, IntegrationMaxDiff, CalibrationMember, CalibrationUncertainty, SamplingReview, Status, and Reason.

predictive

Row-level posterior predictive expected scores, PredictiveSD, ExpectedMeanSD, Residual, ModalScore, and category probabilities when type is "both" or "predictive" (NULL otherwise). IntegrationMaxDiff compares category probabilities and ExpectedMeanSD between quadrature orders for each row. Status and Reason describe predictive availability; PersonStatus describes the separate ability result. Failed predictive checks withhold probabilities and score summaries without suppressing otherwise valid ability results, including prior_only. The IntegrationMaxDiff in estimates concerns ability summaries, log likelihood and cut-score probabilities/SDs only.

decisions

Long cut-score probability table (above_cut and ability_band) with Probability and ProbabilityBetweenSD when cut_scores is supplied (NULL otherwise).

person_draws

Optional per-draw conditional moments when keep_person_draws = TRUE.

source, posterior_decision, categories, data_usage, omitted_rows, settings, notes

Provenance, row accounting, and interpretation notes.

Pass the result to summary(), confint(), as.data.frame(), plot(), mfrm_report(), apa_table(), or export_summary_appendix().

Details

Three Bayesian scoring paradigms

Under the exported adjacent-category logit likelihood (\(D = 1\)), calibration parameters \(\psi = (\beta, \tau, \alpha, \mu, \sigma)\) are estimated on the calibration sample \(y_{\mathrm{cal}}\). When new rating rows \(y_{\mathrm{new}, p}\) arrive for a Person not in \(y_{\mathrm{cal}}\), three distinct quantities exist:

  1. Fixed-calibration posterior mixture (conditioning = "posterior"): $$p_{\mathrm{cal}}(\theta_{\mathrm{new}, p} \mid y_{\mathrm{new}, p}; y_{\mathrm{cal}}) = \int p(\theta_{\mathrm{new}, p} \mid y_{\mathrm{new}, p}, \psi)\, p(\psi \mid y_{\mathrm{cal}})\,d\psi \approx \frac{1}{M}\sum_{m=1}^{M} p(\theta_{\mathrm{new}, p} \mid y_{\mathrm{new}, p}, \psi^{(m)}).$$ New Person responses inform \(\theta_{\mathrm{new}, p}\) conditional on each draw \(\psi^{(m)}\) without reweighting or updating \(\psi\); therefore, a Person's score is invariant to which other new Persons are scored in the same batch. By the law of total variance on the equal-weight \(M\)-component mixture, $$\mathrm{SD}_p^2 = \underbrace{\frac{1}{M}\sum_{m=1}^{M} v_{p,m}}_{\mathrm{WithinSD}_p^2} + \underbrace{\frac{1}{M}\sum_{m=1}^{M}(\mu_{p,m} - \hat{\theta}_p)^2}_{\mathrm{BetweenSD}_p^2},$$ decomposing total posterior variance into conditional measurement variance (WithinSD^2) and calibration posterior variance (BetweenSD^2, share CalibrationVarShare). Median, Lower, and Upper invert the exact continuous mixture CDF \(F_p(x) = M^{-1}\sum_{m=1}^{M} F_{p,m}(x)\).

  2. Posterior-mean plug-in (conditioning = "plugin_mean"): evaluates \(p(\theta_{\mathrm{new}, p} \mid y_{\mathrm{new}, p}, \hat{\psi})\) at marginal posterior means (using \(\hat{\alpha} = \exp(\overline{\log\alpha})\) for one-family GPCM so \(\prod_a \hat{\alpha}_a = 1\) holds). Available even when posterior-draws.rds is absent, but omits calibration uncertainty (BetweenSD = NA).

  3. Joint hierarchical refitting: updates \(\psi\) using both \(y_{\mathrm{cal}}\) and \(y_{\mathrm{new}}\); requires re-exporting the combined data with export_mfrm_model().

Out-of-sample person likelihood vs predictive-draws.rds

Existing-Person log_lik arrays saved in predictive-draws.rds condition on sampled calibration abilities \(\theta_j^{(m)}\) and therefore validate conditional observation fit rather than leave-one-Person-out prediction. For genuinely new Persons (CalibrationMember == FALSE), PersonLogMarginalLikelihood integrates \(\theta_{\mathrm{new}, p}\) over \(\mathcal{N}(\mu^{(m)}, (\sigma^{(m)})^2)\) within each draw before averaging on the probability scale (logMeanExp across \(m = 1, \dots, M\)).

See also

read_mfrm_posterior(), export_mfrm_model(), score_mfrm_calibration(), mfrm_report()

Examples

# 1. Full calibration-posterior mixture scoring from joint MCMC draws:
draws_dir <- system.file("extdata", "posterior-draws-example", package = "mfrmr")
joint_post <- read_mfrm_posterior(draws_dir)
new_ratings <- data.frame(
  Person = c("NewP1", "NewP1", "NewP1", "NewP2", "NewP2", "NewP2"),
  Rater = c("R01", "R02", "R03", "R01", "R02", "R03"),
  Criterion = c("Accuracy", "Content", "Language", "Accuracy", "Content", "Language"),
  Score = c(1, 2, 2, 3, 3, NA),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
scored <- predict(
  joint_post,
  newdata = new_ratings,
  type = "both",
  missing = "omit",
  cut_scores = c(Pass = 0.0, Merit = 1.0)
)
scored$estimates[, c("Person", "Observed", "Estimate", "SD", "WithinSD",
                     "BetweenSD", "Lower", "Upper", "Status")]
#>   Person Observed   Estimate        SD  WithinSD BetweenSD     Lower     Upper
#> 1  NewP1        3 -0.6130990 0.6609947 0.5483797 0.3690443 -2.019002 0.5408901
#> 2  NewP2        2  0.6076407 0.7293054 0.6638066 0.3020715 -0.763545 2.1501629
#>                Status
#> 1 available_posterior
#> 2 available_posterior
scored$decisions[, c("Person", "Type", "Label", "Probability", "ProbabilityBetweenSD")]
#>    Person         Type Label Probability ProbabilityBetweenSD
#> 1   NewP1    above_cut  Pass 0.180393159          0.167990971
#> 2   NewP1    above_cut Merit 0.002417658          0.006630414
#> 3   NewP1 ability_band Band1 0.819606841          0.167990971
#> 4   NewP1 ability_band Band2 0.177975501          0.165324586
#> 5   NewP1 ability_band Band3 0.002417658          0.006630414
#> 6   NewP2    above_cut  Pass 0.806712676          0.113214909
#> 7   NewP2    above_cut Merit 0.273303346          0.148705013
#> 8   NewP2 ability_band Band1 0.193287324          0.113214909
#> 9   NewP2 ability_band Band2 0.533409330          0.106626782
#> 10  NewP2 ability_band Band3 0.273303346          0.148705013
head(scored$predictive[, c("Person", "Rater", "Criterion", "ObservedScore",
                           "ExpectedScore", "PredictiveSD")])
#>   Person Rater Criterion ObservedScore ExpectedScore PredictiveSD
#> 1  NewP1   R01  Accuracy             1      2.022829    0.8962713
#> 2  NewP1   R02   Content             2      2.280687    0.9717236
#> 3  NewP1   R03  Language             2      1.912503    0.9971508
#> 4  NewP2   R01  Accuracy             3      2.808508    0.8418570
#> 5  NewP2   R02   Content             3      2.995436    0.9054100
#> 6  NewP2   R03  Language            NA      2.905937    1.1059390
p_int <- plot(scored, type = "intervals", draw = FALSE)
plot_data(p_int, "table")[, c("Person", "Estimate", "Lower", "Upper", "Display")]
#>   Person   Estimate     Lower     Upper                  Display
#> 1  NewP1 -0.6130990 -2.019002 0.5408901 Sampling review required
#> 2  NewP2  0.6076407 -0.763545 2.1501629 Sampling review required

# 2. Marginal summary bundle without joint draws (explicit plug-in mean mode):
sum_dir <- system.file("extdata", "posterior-example", package = "mfrmr")
sum_post <- read_mfrm_posterior(sum_dir)
new_task_ratings <- data.frame(
  Person = c("CandidateA", "CandidateA"),
  Task = c("t1", "t2"),
  Rater = c("r1", "r2"),
  Score = c(2, 3),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
plugin_scores <- predict(sum_post, newdata = new_task_ratings,
                         conditioning = "plugin_mean")
plugin_scores$estimates[, c("Person", "Estimate", "SD", "BetweenSD", "Status")]
#>       Person  Estimate        SD BetweenSD                Status
#> 1 CandidateA 0.8543098 0.7136646        NA available_conditional
